Title: Nose Filler Turning Your Nose Pale? Watch for These 3 Warning Signs

Description:
A blocked blood vessel from a nose filler injection is rare, but it moves fast - tissue can only survive without oxygen for a few hours. Here are three warning signs worth knowing: pain that keeps getting worse instead of easing, skin that turns pale and then a mottled purple within hours, and losing track of the golden window to act.

If your nose stays pale and the pain won't ease, contact your provider or go to urgent care right away. Before your next filler appointment, ask if the clinic uses ultrasound guidance and keeps hyaluronidase on hand for emergencies.
